concept: A link is a key that travels. One marker world: the budget draft sits inside three rough rings (anyone with the link, people in the company, named people), and the same hand-drawn forward arrow shows how far a link reaches on each setting; the key is drawn early and handed back at the end.

story.metaphor: a link is a key that travels; named people is a door that checks who you are
story.arc: a link reaches a stranger; three rings explain who can open it; view versus edit; a forward travels to the edge of each ring; checks before and after; the budget link redrawn safely

cast.name: Mia
cast.role: presenter, seen only in b03 and b25

devices.what: the one budget draft page (kit part budget_page), the same page every time
one rough hand-drawn key standing for the link (kit part link_key): drawn, handed on, crossed out and returned
three concentric rough rings around the page (kit part access_rings) with the door and the name list (kit part name_list); one board gains a ring per beat
the bent marker forward arrow from one holder to the next (engine W.arrow, ink), the same arrow every time the link travels
a pocket rule written as one line under the board with one accent underline
the wipe join (dir right) at each section turn; camera pans and continue joins inside a section

value_script.why: a clean white board, ink with one accent mark per beat
the key mechanism, how a link travels: the rings carry light hachure and the board is at its fullest
the close lifts back to a clean board for the checks and the payoff

parts.what: The budget draft as a rough hand-drawn page (portrait, folded top right corner), its title Budget draft written by the engine hand at the top, three scribbled figure lines below (marks, no digits). Opts {w, h}. States: plain; edited (one figure line gets a pencil change mark drawn on it, via setState('edited', t, {pen})). Ink only; the caller chooses an accent pen for the edit mark.

One rough hand key (round bow with a hole, a shaft, two teeth), drawn by the engine hand in one group, about 160 by 70 at size 1. Opts {w, h, pen}. States: drawn; crossed (a single cross stroke over it, pen chosen by the caller). The same key in every beat.

Three concentric rough rings (hand circles, not perfect) centred on a point: anyone (widest), company (middle), named (inner, small). Each ring is drawn separately on its own cue: showRing(name, t, {by}). A label for each ring written beside it to the right with a short leader (Anyone with the link, People in the company, Named people), written only when the caller asks: label(name, t). The inner ring carries a small door on its right edge: door states shut or open. Optional light hachure inside a ring (hatch(name, t)), at most one ring hatched at a time. Must work at full board size (outer radius about 380) and as a small muted recall sketch (outer radius about 90, no labels). Exposes each ring's centre and radius so callers can place pictograms inside, outside and at the edge.

A short rough list card: three rows, each a small person mark (Lucide user at marker weight) and a scribbled line, no written names. States: check(i, t) draws a small tick beside row i; strike(i, t) strikes row i through. Sits beside the inner ring's door.
